title: Ko‘chirma gap asoslari
goal_uz: Dars oxirida boshqalarning gapini to‘g‘ri zamon, olmosh va fe’llar bilan (said, told, asked) yetkaza olasiz va bugun bo‘lgan suhbatingiz haqida 5 ta ko‘chirma gap aytasiz.

scenes.title: Ko‘chirma gap bilan tanishuv
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yangi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda atrof-muhit va ekologiya haqida gaplashdik. Bugun esa boshqa odamlarning gapini yetkazishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida bugun bo‘lgan suhbatni ingliz tilida to‘g‘ri va tabiiy qilib hikoya qila olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we'll learn how to report what other people said. By the end of the lesson, you'll be able to tell someone about a conversation you had, using the right tenses, pronouns and reporting verbs.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! Bugun boshqa odamlar nima degani haqida gapirib berishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida o‘zingiz qilgan suhbat haqida to‘g‘ri zamonlar, olmoshlar va fe’llar bilan hikoya qila olasiz.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri va ko‘chirma gap
board: Reported: She said (that) she was tired.

examples.t: "I like this film," Tom said.
Tom said (that) he liked the film.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi tushuncha. Biror kishining so‘zini aynan o‘zicha keltirsak, bu to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri gap: tirnoq ichida, kishining o‘z ovozi bilan. Mazmunini o‘z so‘zimiz bilan yetkazsak, bu ko‘chirma gap, ingliz tilida reported speech. Unda tirnoq yo‘q, “said” fe’lidan keyin esa ko‘pincha “that” keladi.
scenes.say: There are two ways to share someone's words. Direct speech repeats them exactly, inside quotation marks. Reported speech gives the meaning in our own words, usually after said, and the word that is optional.
scenes.say_uz: Birovning gapini ikki yo‘l bilan yetkazish mumkin. To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri gap so‘zlarni aynan, tirnoq ichida takrorlaydi. Ko‘chirma gap esa mazmunni o‘z so‘zlarimiz bilan beradi, odatda said dan keyin, that so‘zi ixtiyoriy.

scenes.title: O‘zbek tili bilan taqqoslash
board: English: She said (that) she was tired.

examples.t: She said she was tired.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida ko‘chirma gap oson: “Men charchadim”, deb aytdi, yoki “charchaganini aytdi”. Fe’l zamoni deyarli o‘zgarmaydi. Ingliz tilida esa qoida boshqacha: gapni o‘tgan zamonda yetkazganimizda, ichidagi fe’l ham, odatda, bir pog‘ona o‘tmishga siljiydi. Bu siljish backshift deyiladi.
scenes.say: In English the verb usually moves one step back in time. She said, I am tired becomes She said she was tired. This step back is called backshift, and it is the main difficulty of reported speech.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida fe’l odatda vaqt bo‘yicha bir qadam orqaga suriladi. I am tired degan gap She said she was tired bo‘ladi. Bu qadam backshift deyiladi va ko‘chirma gapning asosiy qiyinchiligidir.

scenes.title: Zamonlar siljishi: hozirgi zamon

examples.t: "I work in a bank." → She said she worked in a bank.
"We are waiting." → They said they were waiting.

scenes.say_native: Qoidaning birinchi qismi: hozirgi zamon o‘tgan zamonga aylanadi. “Am, is, are” bo‘ladi “was, were”. Present simple, masalan “I work”, bo‘ladi past simple, “she worked”. Present continuous, “we are waiting”, bo‘ladi past continuous, “they were waiting”.
scenes.say: Present tenses move into the past. Am, is and are become was and were. I work becomes she worked. We are waiting becomes they were waiting.
scenes.say_uz: Hozirgi zamonlar o‘tmishga o‘tadi. Am, is, are bo‘ladi was, were. I work bo‘ladi she worked. We are waiting bo‘ladi they were waiting.

scenes.title: Zamonlar siljishi: o‘tgan va kelasi
board: will → would · can → could · must → had to

examples.t: "I've finished." → He said he had finished.
"I'll call you." → She said she would call me.
"I can swim." → He said he could swim.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi qism. Present perfect bo‘ladi past perfect: “I’ve finished” — “he had finished”. Past simple ham ko‘pincha past perfect bo‘ladi: “I met her” — “he had met her”. Kelasi zamon: “will” bo‘ladi “would”, “can” bo‘ladi “could”. “Must” esa ko‘pincha “had to” ga aylanadi.
scenes.say: Present perfect becomes past perfect: I've finished, he had finished. Will becomes would and can becomes could. Must often becomes had to. Past simple usually becomes past perfect, too.
scenes.say_uz: Present perfect past perfect ga aylanadi. Will would ga, can could ga aylanadi. Must ko‘pincha had to bo‘ladi. Past simple ham odatda past perfect bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: O‘zgarmaydigan modal fe’llar
board: would · could · should · might · ought to

examples.t: "You should rest." → She said I should rest.
"It might rain." → He said it might rain.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi xabar: ba’zi fe’llar o‘zgarmaydi. Allaqachon o‘tmish shaklidagi modallar, ya’ni “would, could, should, might” va “ought to” o‘z holicha qoladi. Past perfect, ya’ni “had” plus uchinchi shakl, ham o‘zgarmaydi. Demak, “You should rest” ko‘chirma gapda ham “should” bo‘lib qoladi.
scenes.say: Some verbs do not change. Would, could, should, might and ought to stay the same, and so does the past perfect. You should rest becomes She said I should rest.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zi fe’llar o‘zgarmaydi. Would, could, should, might, ought to shunday qoladi, past perfect ham. You should rest She said I should rest bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Siljishni unutish
board: ✗ He said he is tired. (o‘tgan gapda)
✗ She said she will come. → ✓ would come
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — siljishni unutish. O‘zbek tilida zamon o‘zgarmagani uchun “He said he is tired” deyishga ko‘nikamiz. Bu yerda ikki xato aralashib ketadi: biz o‘tmishda aytilganini yetkazyapmiz, shuning uchun ingliz tili “was” ni talab qiladi. Xuddi shunday “She said she will come” noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “She said she would come”. Kelasi zamon ham orqaga suriladi.
scenes.say: A common mistake is forgetting the backshift. He said he is tired is wrong. Say he said he was tired. And she said she will come should be she said she would come.
scenes.say_uz: Keng tarqalgan xato — siljishni unutish. He said he is tired noto‘g‘ri. He said he was tired deng. She said she will come esa she said she would come bo‘lishi kerak.

scenes.title: Zamonni siljiting
scenes.say_native: Mashq vaqti. Har bir gapni “She said” bilan boshlab ko‘chirma gapga aylantiring. Birinchi: “I live in Tashkent”. Ikkinchi: “We are studying”. Uchinchi: “I’ll help you”. Olmoshlar haqida hozircha o‘ylamang, faqat fe’lni o‘zgartiring. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Report these with She said. One: I live in Tashkent. Two: We are studying. Three: I'll help you.
scenes.say_uz: Bularni She said bilan yetkazing. Bir: I live in Tashkent. Ikki: We are studying. Uch: I'll help you.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) She said she lived in Tashkent.
3) She said she would help me.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “She said she lived in Tashkent”, present simple past simple bo‘ldi. Ikkinchi: “She said they were studying”, “we” ning o‘rniga “they” keldi, buni birozdan keyin ko‘ramiz, fe’l esa past continuous bo‘ldi. Uchinchi: “She said she would help me”, “will” ning o‘rniga “would”, “you” esa “me” ga aylandi. Agar fe’llarni to‘g‘ri siljitgan bo‘lsangiz, barakalla.
scenes.say: One: She said she lived in Tashkent. Two: She said they were studying. Three: She said she would help me.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: She said she lived in Tashkent. Ikki: She said they were studying. Uch: She said she would help me.

scenes.title: Olmoshlar o‘zgaradi
board: my → his / her · you → me / us

examples.t: Anna: "I love my job." → Anna said she loved her job.
Ali: "You can use my car." → Ali said I could use his car.
examples.uz: Ali uning mashinasidan foydalanishim mumkinligini aytdi.

scenes.say_native: Endi olmoshlar. Gapni boshqa odam nomidan yetkazamiz, shuning uchun “I” gapirgan kishiga qarab “he” yoki “she” bo‘ladi. “We” bo‘ladi “they”, “my” bo‘ladi “his” yoki “her”. Eng muhimi, o‘zingizdan so‘rang: bu gapni kim kimga aytdi? Agar o‘zingiz gapirgan bo‘lsangiz, “I” o‘z holicha qoladi.
scenes.say: Pronouns change with the speaker. I becomes he or she, we becomes they, and my becomes his or her. Ask yourself who said it and who is telling the story now.
scenes.say_uz: Olmoshlar gapirgan kishiga qarab o‘zgaradi. I he yoki she, we they, my his yoki her bo‘ladi. O‘zingizdan so‘rang: kim aytdi va hozir kim hikoya qilyapti.

scenes.title: Vaqt va joy so‘zlari
board: tomorrow → the next day / the following day
here → there · this → that · ago → before

examples.t: "I'll see you tomorrow." → He said he would see me the next day.
"I live here." → She said she lived there.

scenes.say_native: Vaqt va joy so‘zlari ham o‘zgaradi, chunki hikoya qilayotgan vaqtimiz va joyimiz boshqa. “Now” bo‘ladi “then”, “today” bo‘ladi “that day”. “Yesterday” — “the day before”, “tomorrow” — “the next day” yoki “the following day”. “Here” bo‘ladi “there”, “this” bo‘ladi “that”, “ago” bo‘ladi “before”. “Next week” esa “the following week”.
scenes.say: Time and place words change, too. Now becomes then, today becomes that day, yesterday becomes the day before, and tomorrow becomes the next day. Here becomes there, and this becomes that.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqt va joy so‘zlari ham o‘zgaradi. Now then, today that day, yesterday the day before, tomorrow the next day bo‘ladi. Here there, this that bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Ertaga ertaga bo‘lib qolmaydi
board: ✗ He said he would come tomorrow.
✓ He said he would come the next day.
✗ She said she was busy now. → ✓ then
scenes.say_native: Yana bir xato: “tomorrow” ni o‘zgartirmasdan qoldirish. Tasavvur qiling, dushanba kuni biror kishi “Ertaga kelaman” dedi. Siz esa payshanba kuni “He said he would come tomorrow” desangiz, ma’no buziladi: payshanbaga nisbatan ertaga emas edi. Shuning uchun “the next day” deymiz.
scenes.say: Be careful with tomorrow. If someone said I'll come tomorrow last Monday, don't say he would come tomorrow. Say he would come the next day. The time of telling is different from the time of speaking.
scenes.say_uz: Tomorrow bilan ehtiyot bo‘ling. Agar kimdir o‘tgan dushanba I'll come tomorrow degan bo‘lsa, he would come tomorrow demang. He would come the next day deng. Hikoya vaqti gapirilgan vaqtdan farq qiladi.

scenes.title: To‘liq o‘zgartirish
scenes.say_native: Endi hammasini birgalikda: fe’l, olmosh va vaqt so‘zlari. Birinchi: Ali, “I’m busy today”. Ikkinchi: Dilya, “We moved here last year”. Uchinchi: Tom, “I’ll call you tomorrow”, bu yerda “you” ni “me” deb oling. Har birini “said” bilan boshlang va baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Change everything. One: Ali, I'm busy today. Two: Dilya, We moved here last year. Three: Tom, I'll call you tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Hammasini o‘zgartiring. Bir: Ali, I'm busy today. Ikki: Dilya, We moved here last year. Uch: Tom, I'll call you tomorrow.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Ali said he was busy that day.
2) Dilya said they had moved there the year before.
3) Tom said he would call me the next day.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Ali said he was busy that day”: “I” ning o‘rniga “he”, “am” ning o‘rniga “was”, “today” ning o‘rniga “that day”. Ikkinchi: “Dilya said they had moved there the year before”: past simple past perfect bo‘ldi, “here” — “there”, “last year” — “the year before”. Uchinchi: “Tom said he would call me the next day”.
scenes.say: One: Ali said he was busy that day. Two: Dilya said they had moved there the year before. Three: Tom said he would call me the next day.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Ali said he was busy that day. Ikki: Dilya said they had moved there the year before. Uch: Tom said he would call me the next day.

scenes.title: Say va tell
board: tell me · tell him · tell the team

examples.t: She said that she was late.
She told me that she was late.

scenes.say_native: Endi fe’llar. “Say” va “tell” ikkalasi ham “aytmoq”, lekin ishlatilishi farq qiladi. “Tell” dan keyin albatta kimga aytilgani keladi: “told me, told him, told the team”. “Say” dan keyin odam kelmaydi: “said that”. Agar kimga aytilganini ko‘rsatmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, “said to me” deysiz.
scenes.say: Say and tell both mean to speak, but they work differently. After tell, you need a person: told me, told him. After say, no person is needed. If you want one, use said to me.
scenes.say_uz: Say va tell ikkalasi gapirmoq degani, lekin ishlatilishi farqli. Tell dan keyin odam kerak: told me, told him. Say dan keyin odam shart emas. Odam kerak bo‘lsa, said to me deyiladi.

scenes.title: Said me va told that
board: ✗ He said me that he was ill.
✓ He told me that he was ill.
✗ He told that he was ill. → ✓ He said (that)...
scenes.say_native: Ikkita klassik xato. Birinchisi: “He said me”. Bunday ibora yo‘q: odam bo‘lsa, “told me” yoki “said to me” deyiladi. Ikkinchisi: “He told that he was ill”. Bu ham noto‘g‘ri, chunki “tell” dan keyin odam kerak: “He told us that he was ill” yoki “He said that he was ill”. Sodda qoida: odam bor bo‘lsa — tell, odam yo‘q bo‘lsa — say.
scenes.say: Two classic mistakes. He said me is wrong, so use told me or said to me. He told that he was ill is also wrong, because tell needs a person. If there is a person, use tell. If not, use say.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita klassik xato. He said me noto‘g‘ri, told me yoki said to me deng. He told that he was ill ham noto‘g‘ri, chunki tell odamni talab qiladi. Odam bo‘lsa tell, bo‘lmasa say ishlating.

scenes.title: Say yoki tell?
board: 3) They ___ us the shop was closed.
scenes.say_native: Bo‘sh joylarga “said” yoki “told” ni qo‘ying. Birinchi: “He blank me he was late”. Ikkinchi: “She blank that she was hungry”. Uchinchi: “They blank us the shop was closed”. Har bir gapda bo‘sh joydan keyin odam bormi yoki yo‘qmi, shunga qarang. Esda tuting: “told” dan keyin doim me, him, us kabi odam keladi, “said” dan keyin esa to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri gap boshlanadi. Baland ovozda aytib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Choose said or told. One: He blank me he was late. Two: She blank that she was hungry. Three: They blank us the shop was closed.
scenes.say_uz: Said yoki told ni tanlang. Bir: He blank me he was late. Ikki: She blank that she was hungry. Uch: They blank us the shop was closed.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “told”, chunki keyin “me” bor. Ikkinchi: “said”, chunki keyin “that” keladi va odam yo‘q. Uchinchi: “told”, chunki keyin “us”. Yodlash uchun oddiy usul: “told” ning orqasidan odam, “said” ning orqasidan gap. Bu qoida sizni xatodan saqlaydi.
scenes.say: One: told, because me follows. Two: said, because there is no person. Three: told, because us follows.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: told, chunki keyin me bor. Ikki: said, chunki odam yo‘q. Uch: told, chunki keyin us bor.

scenes.title: Ask va savollar

examples.t: "Do you like tea?" → She asked me if I liked tea.
"Where do you live?" → He asked where I lived.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi fe’l — “ask”, so‘ramoq. Savollarni yetkazganda ikki tur bor. Ha yoki yo‘q javobli savolda “if” yoki “whether” ishlatamiz: “She asked me if I liked tea”. So‘roq so‘zli savolda esa shu so‘roq so‘zning o‘zi qoladi: “He asked where I lived”. Zamon qoidasi o‘sha-o‘sha: bir qadam orqaga. Savol belgisi esa yo‘qoladi, chunki gap endi oddiy darak gapga aylandi.
scenes.say: Ask is used to report questions. For yes or no questions we use if or whether. For questions with a question word, the question word stays. The question mark disappears.
scenes.say_uz: Ask savollarni yetkazish uchun ishlatiladi. Ha yoki yo‘q savollarda if yoki whether ishlatamiz. So‘roq so‘zli savollarda so‘roq so‘z qoladi. Savol belgisi yo‘qoladi.

scenes.title: Tartib: darak gap kabi

examples.t: "What time does it start?" → She asked what time it started.
"Are you ready?" → He asked if I was ready.

scenes.say_native: Eng muhim qoida: ko‘chirma savolda so‘z tartibi darak gapnikidek, ya’ni ega, keyin kesim. Yordamchi “do, does, did” butunlay tushib qoladi, fe’lning o‘zi siljiydi. “What time does it start” — “what time it started”. “Are you ready” — “if I was ready”, bu yerda “are” ega tomonidan orqaga o‘tib, “was” bo‘ladi. Savolning o‘zida tartib teskari, ko‘chirma gapda esa to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: In reported questions, the word order is the same as a statement. The helping verbs do, does and did disappear. What time does it start becomes what time it started.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘chirma savollarda so‘z tartibi darak gapnikidek. Do, does, did yordamchi fe’llari tushib qoladi. What time does it start what time it started bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Savol tartibini saqlash
board: ✗ She asked me where did I live.
✓ She asked me where I lived.
✗ He asked me do I smoke. → ✓ if I smoked
scenes.say_native: Bu darajadagi eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: ko‘chirma gapda savol tartibini saqlab qolish. “She asked me where did I live” noto‘g‘ri. To‘g‘risi “where I lived”. Ha yoki yo‘q savollarda ham xuddi shu: “He asked me do I smoke” noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “if I smoked”. “If” yoki “whether” unutilmasligi kerak.
scenes.say: Don't keep the question order. She asked me where did I live is wrong. Say she asked me where I lived. For yes or no questions, remember if: he asked me if I smoked.
scenes.say_uz: Savol tartibini saqlamang. She asked me where did I live noto‘g‘ri. She asked me where I lived deng. Ha yoki yo‘q savollarda if ni unutmang: he asked me if I smoked.

scenes.title: Savollarni yetkazing
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolni “She asked me” bilan boshlab yetkazing. Birinchi: “Do you speak French?” Ikkinchi: “Where did you buy it?” Uchinchi: “Can you help me?” Eslang: ha yoki yo‘q savolda “if”, savol tartibi yo‘q, siljish bor. Birinchi va uchinchi savolda “you” ni “I” ga, ikkinchida ham shunday o‘zgartiring, uchinchida “me” ni “her” deb oling.
scenes.say: Report these with She asked me. One: Do you speak French? Two: Where did you buy it? Three: Can you help me?
scenes.say_uz: Bularni She asked me bilan yetkazing. Bir: Do you speak French? Ikki: Where did you buy it? Uch: Can you help me?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) She asked me if I spoke French.
2) She asked me where I had bought it.
3) She asked me if I could help her.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “She asked me if I spoke French”. “Do” tushdi, “speak” siljib “spoke” bo‘ldi. Ikkinchi: “She asked me where I had bought it”: past simple past perfect bo‘ldi, “did” tushdi. Uchinchi: “She asked me if I could help her”, “can” bo‘ldi “could”, “me” esa “her”, chunki bu yerda yordam so‘rayotgan ayol. Uchalasida ham savol belgisi yo‘q.
scenes.say: One: She asked me if I spoke French. Two: She asked me where I had bought it. Three: She asked me if I could help her.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: She asked me if I spoke French. Ikki: She asked me where I had bought it. Uch: She asked me if I could help her.

scenes.title: Buyruq va iltimos
board: told me to wait · asked us to sit

examples.t: "Wait here." → He told me to wait there.
examples.uz: U menga o‘sha yerda kutishimni aytdi.

examples.t: "Please don't be late." → She asked us not to be late.

scenes.say_native: Buyruq va iltimoslar ham ko‘chirma gapda yetkaziladi. Bu yerda zamon siljishi yo‘q: “tell” yoki “ask”, keyin odam, keyin “to” va fe’l. “Wait here” — “He told me to wait there”. Manfiy shaklda “not to”: “She asked us not to be late”. Buyruq uchun “tell”, muloyim iltimos uchun “ask”.
scenes.say: Orders and requests use tell or ask, then a person, then to and the verb. Wait here becomes he told me to wait there. For negatives, use not to: she asked us not to be late.
scenes.say_uz: Buyruq va iltimoslarda tell yoki ask, keyin odam, keyin to va fe’l keladi. Wait here he told me to wait there bo‘ladi. Inkorda not to: she asked us not to be late.

scenes.title: Boshqa fe’llar

examples.t: She added that she was leaving soon.
He admitted that he had made a mistake.

scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda faqat “said” va “told” bilan cheklanmaymiz. “Explain” — tushuntirmoq, “add” — qo‘shib aytmoq, “reply” — javob bermoq, “mention” — tilga olmoq, “promise” — va’da bermoq, “admit” — tan olmoq, “warn” — ogohlantirmoq. Bularning ko‘pchiligidan keyin ham “that” va siljigan zamon keladi.
scenes.say: You can use other reporting verbs, too: explain, add, reply, mention, promise, admit and warn. Many of them are followed by that and a backshifted verb, as in he promised that he would call.
scenes.say_uz: Boshqa fe’llardan ham foydalanish mumkin: explain, add, reply, mention, promise, admit, warn. Ko‘pchiligidan keyin that va siljigan fe’l keladi: he promised that he would call.

scenes.title: Dialog: ish joyida
board: Manager: "I can't come to the meeting today."
Manager: "I'm at the airport. My flight was late."
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash dialogi. Ish joyi: ofis menejeri uchrashuvga kela olmaydi. Ali unga qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi. Tinglang va menejer nima uchun kela olmayotganini, qayerda ekanini hamda soat o‘n ikkida nima qilishini tushunishga harakat qiling. Keyin sizga savollar beraman.
scenes.say: Listen. Ali: Where are you? Manager: I'm at the airport. My flight was late, so I can't come to the meeting today. Ali: Don't worry. We'll start without you. Manager: Thanks. I'll join you online at noon.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang. Ali: Qayerdasiz? Menejer: Aeroportdaman. Reysim kechikdi, shuning uchun bugun uchrashuvga kela olmayman. Ali: Xavotir olmang. Sizsiz boshlaymiz. Menejer: Rahmat. Soat o‘n ikkida onlayn qo‘shilaman.

scenes.title: Tushunish: dialog
board: 3) What did she say she would do at noon?
scenes.say_native: Endi dialogni ko‘chirma gapda eslab ko‘ring. Birinchi: menejer qayerda edi? Ikkinchi: u nima uchun kela olmadi? Uchinchi: u soat o‘n ikkida nima qilishini aytdi? Javoblarni “She said” bilan boshlang, shunda siljishni mashq qilasiz. Menejerning o‘z so‘zlarini emas, mazmunini ayting.
scenes.say: Answer with She said. One: Where was the manager? Two: Why couldn't she come? Three: What did she say she would do at noon?
scenes.say_uz: She said bilan javob bering. Bir: Menejer qayerda edi? Ikki: Nega kela olmadi? Uch: Soat o‘n ikkida nima qilishini aytdi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) She said she was at the airport.
2) She said her flight had been late.
3) She said she would join them online.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “She said she was at the airport”. Ikkinchi: “She said her flight had been late” — reys oldin kechikkan, shuning uchun past perfect. Uchinchi: “She said she would join them online at noon”, ya’ni soat o‘n ikkida onlayn qo‘shilaman. E’tibor bering: Ali ham gap aytdi, “Don’t worry” — “He told her not to worry”, bu esa buyruq-ko‘chirma shakli.
scenes.say: One: She said she was at the airport. Two: She said her flight had been late. Three: She said she would join them online at noon.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: She said she was at the airport. Ikki: She said her flight had been late. Uch: She said she would join them online at noon.

scenes.title: Dialog: do‘stlar orasida
board: Sara: "Are you coming to the party tonight?"
Tom: "I can't. I have to study."
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki do‘st, Sara va Tom, kechki bayram haqida gaplashadi. Sara Tomni taklif qiladi, Tom esa bandligini aytadi. Tinglang: Tom nima uchun bora olmaydi va nimani o‘qiyapti? Qisqartmalarga, ya’ni “can’t”, “I’m” va “I’ll” ga ham quloq soling.
scenes.say: Listen. Sara: Are you coming to the party tonight? Tom: I can't. I have to study. Sara: What are you studying? Tom: I'm learning for my English test tomorrow. Sara: Good luck! Tom: Thanks. I'll come next time.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang. Sara: Bugun kechqurun bayramga kelasanmi? Tom: Kela olmayman. O‘qishim kerak. Sara: Nimani o‘qiyapsan? Tom: Ertaga ingliz tili testiga tayyorlanyapman. Sara: Omad! Tom: Rahmat. Keyingi safar kelaman.

scenes.title: Savol va javob
board: 1) What did Sara ask Tom first?
2) What did Tom say he had to do?
3) What did Tom say he would do next time?
scenes.say_native: Yana ko‘chirma gap mashqi. Birinchi: Sara Tomdan birinchi navbatda nimani so‘radi? Ikkinchi: Tom nima qilishi kerakligini aytdi? Uchinchi: Tom keyingi safar nima qilishini aytdi? Birinchi javobni “She asked him if” bilan boshlang, ikkinchisini “He said”, uchinchisini ham “He said” bilan.
scenes.say: Report the dialogue. One: What did Sara ask Tom first? Two: What did Tom say he had to do? Three: What did Tom say he would do next time?
scenes.say_uz: Dialogni yetkazing. Bir: Sara Tomdan avval nimani so‘radi? Ikki: Tom nima qilishi kerakligini aytdi? Uch: Tom keyingi safar nima qilishini aytdi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) She asked him if he was coming to the party that night.
2) He said he had to study.
3) He said he would come the next time.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “She asked him if he was coming to the party that night” — “are you coming” bo‘ldi “he was coming”, “tonight” esa “that night”. Ikkinchi: “He said he had to study”. Bu yerda “have to” siljib “had to” bo‘ldi. Uchinchi: “He said he would come next time” yoki “the next time”.
scenes.say: One: She asked him if he was coming to the party that night. Two: He said he had to study. Three: He said he would come next time.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: She asked him if he was coming to the party that night. Ikki: He said he had to study. Uch: He said he would come next time.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: said, told va asked

examples.t: He said he'd already eaten.

scenes.say_native: Talaffuz haqida. “Said” so‘zi yozilishiga qaramay “seid” emas, “sed” deb o‘qiladi, bu “say” fe’lining o‘tgan shakli, shakli “says” ham “sez” bo‘ladi. “Asked” oxirida “kt” jarangsiz birikma, “askt” deb o‘qiladi, “ed” alohida bo‘g‘in emas. Og‘zaki nutqda yana bir narsa: “he’d” qisqartmasi. U “he had” yoki “he would” degani. Gapdan ma’no tushunasiz: “he’d eaten” bo‘lsa, “had”; “he’d come” bo‘lsa, “would”.
scenes.say: Pronunciation matters. Said is pronounced sed, not sayd. Asked ends in a quick kt sound. And in fast speech, he'd can mean he had or he would. He said he'd already eaten.
scenes.say_uz: Talaffuz muhim. Said sed deb o‘qiladi, seyd emas. Asked oxirida tez kt tovushi bor. Tez nutqda he'd he had yoki he would degani bo‘lishi mumkin. He said he'd already eaten.

scenes.title: Reporting verb hozirgi zamonda
board: She says she is tired. (zamon o‘zgarmaydi)
He tells me he works late.

examples.t: She says she's tired.
Jack says he'll be late.

scenes.say_native: Muhim istisno. Agar siz gapni hozirgi zamonda yetkazsangiz, ya’ni “says” yoki “tells” desangiz, zamon siljimaydi. Masalan, telefonda sherigingiz “Men charchadim” dedi va siz darhol “She says she’s tired” deysiz. Mantiq oddiy: gap hozir ham dolzarb. O‘tgan zamon “said” bo‘lgandagina orqaga siljiymiz.
scenes.say: There is an important exception. If the reporting verb is in the present, there is no backshift. She says she is tired. He tells me he works late. Jack says he will be late.
scenes.say_uz: Muhim istisno bor. Agar yetkazuvchi fe’l hozirgi zamonda bo‘lsa, siljish bo‘lmaydi. She says she is tired. He tells me he works late. Jack says he will be late.

scenes.title: Haqiqat hozir ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa
board: She said she lives in Leeds. (hozir ham shunday)
She said she lived in Leeds.

examples.t: He said the earth goes round the sun.
examples.uz: U Yer Quyosh atrofida aylanishini aytdi.

scenes.say_native: Yana bir nuqta. Agar aytilgan gap hozir ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, ingliz tilida ba’zan zamonni siljitmaslik mumkin: “She said she lives in Leeds”, agar u hozir ham Lidsda yashasa. Lekin siljigan shakl, “she lived in Leeds”, ham doim to‘g‘ri. Shuning uchun imtihonda yoki shubhada doim siljitgan shaklni tanlang, bu xavfsiz yo‘l.
scenes.say: If the information is still true now, you can sometimes keep the original tense. She said she lives in Leeds. But the backshifted form, she lived in Leeds, is always correct, so it's the safer choice.
scenes.say_uz: Agar ma’lumot hozir ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, ba’zan asl zamonni saqlash mumkin. She said she lives in Leeds. Lekin siljigan shakl, she lived in Leeds, doim to‘g‘ri, shuning uchun ishonchliroq.

scenes.title: Xatolarni toping
board: 1) He said me he was tired.
2) She asked where did I work.
3) They said they will come tomorrow.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapda xato bor. Birinchi: “He said me he was tired”. Ikkinchi: “She asked where did I work”. Uchinchi: “They said they will come tomorrow”, bu gap o‘tgan hafta aytilgan edi deb tasavvur qiling. Har bir xatoni toping va to‘g‘ri variantni ayting.
scenes.say: Find the mistakes. One: He said me he was tired. Two: She asked where did I work. Three: They said they will come tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Xatolarni toping. Bir: He said me he was tired. Ikki: She asked where did I work. Uch: They said they will come tomorrow.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) He told me he was tired.
3) They said they would come the next day.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “He told me he was tired”, chunki “said me” yo‘q. Ikkinchi: “She asked where I worked”, savol tartibi va “did” tushdi. Uchinchi: “They said they would come the next day”, chunki “will” siljib “would” bo‘ldi va “tomorrow” o‘zgardi. Uchalasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, bugungi darsning eng muhim xatolaridan qutuldingiz.
scenes.say: One: He told me he was tired. Two: She asked where I worked. Three: They said they would come the next day.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: He told me he was tired. Ikki: She asked where I worked. Uch: They said they would come the next day.

scenes.title: Hikoya qilish usuli
scenes.say_native: Endi suhbatni hikoya qilishni o‘rganamiz. Barcha gaplarni “said that” bilan ketma-ket qo‘ysangiz, nutqingiz zerikarli chiqadi. Shuning uchun tartib so‘zlarini qo‘shing: “First, then, after that, in the end”. Fe’llarni almashtiring: “asked, told, explained, added, promised”.
scenes.say: To tell a conversation well, use sequence words and different reporting verbs. First, she asked me. Then I told her. After that, she said. In the end, we agreed. Don't repeat every word, just the main ideas.
scenes.say_uz: Suhbatni yaxshi hikoya qilish uchun tartib so‘zlari va turli fe’llardan foydalaning. First, she asked me. Then I told her. After that, she said. In the end, we agreed. Har so‘zni takrorlamang, asosiy fikrlarni yetkazing.

scenes.title: Namuna hikoya
board: This morning my boss asked me if I could work late.
I told her I had a class, so she said it was fine.
She added that I could leave early on Friday.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. Bugun ertalab rahbarim mendan kechroq ishlay olamanmi, deb so‘radi. Men darsim borligini aytdim, u esa muammo yo‘qligini bildirdi va juma kuni erta ketishim mumkinligini qo‘shib qo‘ydi. Namunada ko‘chirma savol, “told”, “said” va “added” fe’llari qanday ishlatilganini payqang.
scenes.say: This morning my boss asked me if I could work late. I told her I had a class, so she said it was fine. She added that I could leave early on Friday. I thanked her and said I would stay next week.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun ertalab boshliq mendan kechroq ishlay olamanmi deb so‘radi. Men darsim borligini aytdim, shunda u hammasi joyida ekanini aytdi. U juma kuni erta ketishim mumkinligini qo‘shdi. Men minnatdorchilik bildirdim va kelasi hafta qolishimni aytdim.

scenes.title: Sizning navbatingiz
board: What did you ask? What did they say?
scenes.say_native: Endi sizning navbatingiz. Bugun yoki kecha qilgan bitta suhbatingizni eslang: oila a’zosi, hamkasb yoki do‘kondagi sotuvchi bilan. Kamida to‘rtta ko‘chirma gap ayting: bittasida “asked”, bittasida “told”, bittasida “said” bo‘lsin, tartib so‘zlaridan foydalaning. To‘xtatib, o‘zingiz gapiring.
scenes.say: Now your turn. Think of a conversation from today or yesterday. Tell it in four or five sentences. Use asked, told and said, and add sequence words like first and then.
scenes.say_uz: Endi sizning navbatingiz. Bugun yoki kecha bo‘lgan suhbatni o‘ylang. To‘rt-besh gapda hikoya qiling. Asked, told va said dan foydalaning va first, then kabi tartib so‘zlarini qo‘shing.

scenes.title: O‘z-o‘zini tekshirish
board: Savolda if / so‘roq so‘z + darak tartibi?
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingizni tekshiring. Birinchi: fe’l zamoni bir qadam orqaga siljidimi? Ikkinchi: olmoshlar, “tomorrow”, “here” kabi so‘zlar o‘zgardimi? Uchinchi: savolda “if” yoki so‘roq so‘z va darak gap tartibi bormi? To‘rtinchi: “told” dan keyin odam bormi?
scenes.say: Check yourself with four questions. Did the verb move back? Did the pronouns and time words change? Do questions use if or a question word with statement order? Is there a person after tell?
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingizni to‘rt savol bilan tekshiring. Fe’l orqaga siljidimi? Olmosh va vaqt so‘zlari o‘zgardimi? Savollarda if yoki so‘roq so‘z va darak gap tartibi bormi? Tell dan keyin odam bormi?

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Pronouns, time and place words change
say / tell + kim / ask if + darak tartib
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: o‘tgan zamondagi “said” dan keyin zamon bir qadam orqaga siljiydi: hozirgi o‘tgan, “will” — “would”, “can” — “could”. Ikkinchi: olmoshlar, vaqt va joy so‘zlari ham o‘zgaradi. Uchinchi: “told” dan keyin odam keladi, “said” dan keyin yo‘q. To‘rtinchi: ko‘chirma savolda “if” yoki so‘roq so‘z, so‘ng darak gap tartibi, “do” va savol belgisisiz. Beshinchi: “says” bilan siljish yo‘q.
scenes.say: Let's review. After said, the verb moves back, will becomes would and can becomes could. Pronouns and time words change. Tell needs a person. Reported questions use if or a question word, with statement order. After says, there is no backshift.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa. Said dan keyin fe’l orqaga siljiydi, will would, can could bo‘ladi. Olmosh va vaqt so‘zlari o‘zgaradi. Tell odamni talab qiladi. Ko‘chirma savollarda if yoki so‘roq so‘z va darak tartibi ishlatiladi. Says dan keyin siljish yo‘q.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: report a conversation you had today
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: bugun qilgan suhbatingizni yozma yoki og‘zaki hikoya qiling. Kamida beshta ko‘chirma gap bo‘lsin, ulardan bittasi ko‘chirma savol, bittasi “told”, bittasida “said”. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir gapda zamon siljigan, olmoshlar to‘g‘ri va savolda darak tartibi bor. Keyingi darsda fe’lning noaniq shakllarini, ya’ni infinitiv va harakat nomini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to report a conversation you had today. Use at least five reported sentences, including one reported question. Check the backshift, the pronouns and the word order. See you in the next lesson!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: bugun qilgan suhbatingizni yetkazing. Kamida beshta ko‘chirma gap ishlating, ulardan biri savol bo‘lsin. Zamon siljishi, olmoshlar va so‘z tartibini tekshiring. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Bugun qilgan suhbatingizni ingliz tilida yetkazing: kamida 5 ta ko‘chirma gap (said, told, asked), ulardan biri ko‘chirma savol bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: zamon siljigan, olmoshlar to‘g‘ri, savolda darak gap tartibi.

quiz.q: She said, "I am hungry." → She said she ___ hungry.
quiz.why_uz: Am/is/are o‘tgan zamonda bo‘lgan gapda was/were ga siljiydi.

options: He said me he was late.
He told me he was late.
He told that he was late.
He said to that he was late.
quiz.why_uz: Tell dan keyin odam (me) keladi; said me deb bo‘lmaydi.

quiz.q: "I'll call you tomorrow." → He said he ___ me the next day.
quiz.why_uz: Will would ga, tomorrow the next day ga o‘zgaradi.

quiz.q: "Where do you live?" → She asked me ___.
quiz.why_uz: Ko‘chirma savolda darak tartibi bor, do/did yo‘q, fe’l siljiydi.

quiz.q: "Do you like coffee?" → He asked me ___ coffee.
quiz.why_uz: Ha/yo‘q savolda if/whether kerak, tartib darak gapniki.
Present perfect past perfect ga o‘tadi.

quiz.q: Which verb stays the same in reported speech?
quiz.why_uz: Should o‘zgarmaydi; will would, can could, am was bo‘ladi.

quiz.q: "I live here." → She said she lived ___.
Jack is calling now: "I'm late." You say: Jack ___ he's late.
quiz.why_uz: Hozirgi zamon yetkazuvchi fe’l (says) bo‘lsa, siljish bo‘lmaydi.

quiz.q: "Don't touch it." → She told me ___ it.
quiz.why_uz: Inkor buyruq: told + kim + not to + fe’l.
